title: Master of Gorgons
problem: Bonus has no trait check: every Gorgon gets it, trait does nothing. Confirmed in game 2026-10-19.
notes: Fix: H: add the trait gate 2026-10-26: user re-test confirms the bug is still present (no patch yet). Patch built: C hook on the block's bc_CountRace call.

release_notes.intended: Your creatures deal 35% more damage to Stoned enemies for each Gorgon on your side.
release_notes.actual: The game gave the bonus to any side with Gorgons, even when nobody on that side had Master of Gorgons.
release_notes.fix: Now the bonus only applies when the attacker's side has the trait.
